features.title: Speed dial view, from the rail, with its empty state
Notes tagged speed-dial become tiles: the link opens the site, no link opens the note, favicon or letter
A note with several links is a group, its rules start new rows
Filter the tiles by name or link, clear it, no match message
Tile size slider, kept by the account
Right click the name of a group to colour it, Default takes the colour off
Drag the tiles into a new order, which stays
?focus=1 and ?focus=0 in the address of the view
Background image and opacity of the view, from the ... menu
Add a note to the speed dial and remove it, from the note toolbar and from the tree
Add the notes of a folder to the speed dial through the tag dialog, then remove them
Put the favorite notes on the speed dial from the Favorites menu, and take them off
Several speed dials: create, choose one from the note menu, rename, delete
Element visibility of the view: title, workspace, filter, group names and rules, frames, icons, names, switcher, new, size, pencil
